_comment: Template for the per-build memory layout the Cheat Engine discovery produces. Copy to layout.<sha256-prefix>.json and fill the FILL_ME fields as each Phase-0 step succeeds. Offsets shown are STARTING HINTS cribbed from the open Hexorg v1.3 table (RESEARCH_memory_reader.md appendix) and MUST be re-verified on the user's 1.19.x build - they will likely differ.

build.note: Reader MUST refuse to run unless the live exe sha256 matches one in this manifest (fail closed - no silent misreads).

date.addr: FILL_ME absolute, or use rip/sig below
date.kind: FILL_ME prefer a monotonic num_days/tick counter over a Y/M/D field
date.note: Daily trigger AND torn-read sentinel. Must tick exactly once per in-game day and be stable when paused.
date.anchor_sig: FILL_ME optional AOB at a code site that loads this global

player_country_chain.base: FILL_ME absolute address of the pPlayer global
player_country_chain.note: Resolves to the player's Country object base. Crib the current chain from the FearLess 1.19.1 table in CE.

country_object.note: Fixed-point: many scalars are stored x1000 / x10 / x32.768. Verify each against the UI.

country_container.base: FILL_ME global that holds the country array/manager
country_container.kind: FILL_ME ptr_array | msvc_vector | id_indexed | handle_table | pool
country_container.count: FILL_ME (or end/cap offsets for an msvc vector triple)
country_container.note: Found by searching for the 8-byte player Country* value and walking up to what points to it. 'All countries' may include dormant/releasable tags - filter to live tags by validity.

division_example.loc_addr_or_chain: FILL_ME address/chain to ONE division's current province id
division_example.note: Must track the division's ACTUAL current province (not move-order destination / UI selection). This is the gate on the daily division time-lapse stretch goal.

validators.note: Hard sanity bounds; reads outside these => mark layout broken and stop publishing (RESEARCH section 3).
